subject: Rough order magnitude: token spend projection + PO readiness
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@brightlyhealth.com>, Brightly Health Procurement <procurement@brightlyhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + estimated monthly spend bands (post-demo)

Hi Anita (and procurement team),

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the candid walk-through of your clinical triage flows. Per our call, I promised a quick, pragmatic breakdown of monthly spend scenarios and a note on procurement thresholds so you can map this to your finance/IT runway. Attached is a very light "Rough OM" with three consumption profiles. Key takeaways below: 

- Target unit econ: we modeled $28 / 1M tokens as the base for the L2 inference profile (512 seq, mixed prompts/responses). That’s our mid-case; heavy-context scenarios move toward $40 / 1M.
- Monthly spend bands we sketched:
  - Small pilot: $2k–$8k / month (~0.07–0.3B tokens)
  - Production Lite: $10k–$45k / month (~0.35–1.6B tokens)
  - Production Standard: $60k–$180k / month (~2.1–6.4B tokens)

- Procurement note: our standard PO threshold for a managed Dedicated contract is $50k+ (monthly commit) to enable reserved capacity pricing and SLA. Under $50k, the hosted pay-as-you-go path is typical and faster to sign.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm which band feels closest to your expectations, 2) we send a tailored quote + sample SOW, 3) if $50k+ commit looks likely we'll route to our enterprise procurement checklist (we can pre-populate fields). I attached one-page numbers and a sample quote stub.

If helpful, happy to run a 20-minute finance-only call with your procurement lead to walk the numbers and answer questions about billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and PO language.

Thanks — looking forward to your signal.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Rough_OM_Token_Scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: Redwood_Sales_Quote_7821.pdf (PDF)

From: Anita Rao <anita@brightlyhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Brightly Health Procurement <procurement@brightlyhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + estimated monthly spend bands (post-demo)

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear write-up and the spreadsheet. Our initial read:

- The Production Lite band (10k–45k) aligns with what our product team expects for the next 6 months. We’ll likely sit around 20k–30k / month to start as usage ramps.
- We are unlikely to do a reserved capacity commit immediately — standard PO process here requires > $75k annual spend to hit our preferred procurement lane (that maps to ~6.5k/month in your mid-case, but procurement prefers annualized view).
- For quoting: can you provide two quote flavors?
  1) Hosted pay-as-you-go at your standard per-1M token rates (monthly billing)
  2) 12-month commit (if we annualize to >= $75k) with discounted unit price and a 30-day SLA clause.

Procurement also asked for a simple summary of billing cadence, minimum PO amount you accept, and standard invoice terms (Net 30). If you can send a one-pager, we can circulate to finance.

Thanks,
Anita
Head of Product Operations | Brightly Health
Anita@brightlyhealth.com

--
Procurement note (procurement@brightlyhealth.com): we handle legal + PO. We'll need sample SOW and a redline window of 3 business days once legal receives the draft.

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@brightlyhealth.com>, Brightly Health Procurement <procurement@brightlyhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + estimated monthly spend bands (post-demo)

Anita — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Per your ask I attached two succinct quote flavors and a short billing/terms summary:

1) Hosted PAYG: $28 / 1M tokens (standard runtime, shared pool). Monthly invoicing, Net 30. No minimum PO required but invoices > $25k will go through procurement routing.

2) 12-month annualized: if you annualize spend to >= $75k (equivalent to roughly $6.25k/month in committed spend) we can offer $22 / 1M tokens with a 60% overage cap guardrail and a 30-day SLA. This pricing assumes a 12-mo term, monthly reporting, and a single point of contact for usage queries.

Notes on how we calculated: mid-case token rate uses 512 average seq and 35% cache hit (conservative). Heavy-context scenarios (1k+ seq) push unit to $38–$42 / 1M tokens depending on KV cache reuse.

Procurement specifics: Redwood accepts PO for both flavors. For the annualized commit we require a signed MSA + SOW; typical legal redline window we request is 5 business days but we'll do our best to meet your 3-day ask. Sample SOW + MSA attached.

I also dropped a DocuSign link for the quote so procurement can review the financials quickly. If you want, Jordan can join the procurement call to run the finance details.

Cheers,
Chloe
